propositions: explain guide lookup fails with missing-file when rebar is installed as a library and run against a project that lacks docs/ tree because repo_root resolves to the consuming project's git toplevel instead of the rebar package
author guides must be accessible from any rebar installation (CLI, MCP, Python library) independent of repo-root by moving canonical copies into the importlib.resources-accessible package directory
explain_guide(name) should resolve guide filenames via resources.files('rebar._guides') instead of config.repo_root()/docs/ to guarantee installability
explain_criterion(id) should render sections from the packaged criteria registry directly instead of reading docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md from repo-root
docs/writing-a-passing-plan.md and docs/passing-code-review.md must remain as thin pointer files so existing external links (docs/README.md, AGENTS.md) continue to resolve
both prose guides must be shipped in the wheel as packaged resources under src/rebar/_guides/ following the OSS convention already used for criteria_routing.json
